modules.title: Foundations of Discrete Mathematics
modules.description: Build foundational knowledge in logic, set theory, and proof techniques to address weak areas in logical reasoning and mathematical concepts.

sub_modules.title: 1.1 Propositional Logic
sub_modules.description: Understand the basics of propositional logic and truth tables.

activities.title: Understanding Propositions
activities.description: Learn to identify propositions and their truth values.
learning_objectives: Define propositions and logical connectives (AND, OR, NOT, etc.)
Construct truth tables for compound propositions

activities.title: Logical Connectives and Equivalences
activities.description: Explore logical equivalences and their applications.
learning_objectives: Identify logical equivalences (e.g., De Morgan's Laws)
Simplify logical expressions using equivalences

sub_modules.title: 1.2 Set Theory
sub_modules.description: Master set operations and their role in mathematical reasoning.

activities.title: Set Operations and Notation
activities.description: Learn to represent and manipulate sets.
learning_objectives: Understand union, intersection, complement, and Cartesian products
Apply set notation to solve problems

activities.title: Venn Diagrams and Applications
activities.description: Visualize set relationships and solve real-world problems.
learning_objectives: Use Venn diagrams to represent set operations
Solve problems involving set intersections and unions

modules.title: Problem-Solving and Logical Reasoning
modules.description: Enhance problem-solving skills and logical reasoning through structured practice.

sub_modules.title: 2.1 Proof Techniques
sub_modules.description: Learn formal proof methods to strengthen logical reasoning.

activities.title: Direct and Indirect Proofs
activities.description: Master proof techniques for mathematical statements.
learning_objectives: Construct direct proofs using logical deductions
Apply proof by contradiction and contrapositive

activities.title: Mathematical Induction
learning_objectives: Understand the principle of mathematical induction
Prove statements about integers using induction

sub_modules.title: 2.2 Problem-Solving Strategies
sub_modules.description: Develop systematic approaches to tackle complex problems.

activities.title: Divide and Conquer
activities.description: Break down problems into smaller subproblems.
learning_objectives: Apply divide-and-conquer strategies to combinatorial problems
Solve recurrence relations using decomposition

activities.title: Case Analysis and Enumeration
activities.description: Use case analysis to explore all possible scenarios.
learning_objectives: Solve problems using exhaustive case analysis
Count permutations and combinations systematically

modules.title: Advanced Topics and Applications
modules.description: Apply discrete mathematics to computer science through advanced topics.

sub_modules.title: 3.1 Graph Theory
sub_modules.description: Explore graph theory and its applications in algorithms.

activities.title: Graph Representation and Traversal
activities.description: Understand graph structures and traversal algorithms.
learning_objectives: Represent graphs using adjacency matrices and lists
Implement BFS and DFS algorithms

activities.title: Shortest Path and Connectivity
activities.description: Solve problems involving shortest paths and connectivity.
learning_objectives: Apply Dijkstra's and Floyd-Warshall algorithms
Analyze graph connectivity and spanning trees

sub_modules.title: 3.2 Combinatorics and Probability
sub_modules.description: Master combinatorial principles and probability for algorithm analysis.

activities.title: Counting Principles
activities.description: Apply combinatorial techniques to count discrete structures.
learning_objectives: Use permutations, combinations, and the inclusion-exclusion principle
Solve problems involving binomial coefficients

activities.title: Probability and Random Variables
activities.description: Analyze probabilistic models for computer science applications.
learning_objectives: Calculate probabilities for discrete events
Understand expected values and variance

modules.title: Motivation and Study Techniques
modules.description: Improve motivation and learning efficiency through structured strategies.

sub_modules.title: 4.1 Active Learning Strategies
sub_modules.description: Implement techniques to maintain motivation and focus.

activities.title: Spaced Repetition and Practice
activities.description: Use spaced repetition to reinforce concepts.
learning_objectives: Create a study schedule with spaced repetition intervals
Review key concepts weekly to improve retention

activities.title: Gamification and Rewards
activities.description: Use gamified activities to stay motivated.
learning_objectives: Track progress with quiz scores and milestones
Reward completion of modules with small incentives

sub_modules.title: 4.2 Real-World Applications
sub_modules.description: Connect concepts to computer science to maintain relevance.

activities.title: Discrete Math in Algorithms
activities.description: Explore how discrete math underpins computer science.
learning_objectives: Analyze sorting and searching algorithms using discrete math
Understand the role of graph theory in network design

activities.title: Project-Based Learning
learning_objectives: Design a simple algorithm using graph theory
Implement a combinatorial optimization problem
